Message.Name: Statistics Message
Message.Description: The Statistics message provides statistics including turnover. Statistics messages for different markets (SSE and SZSE) are sent via different channels.

Field.Name: SecurityCode
Field.Description: Uniquely identifies a security available for trading. 6 digit security codes with possible values 1 to 999999.

Field.Name: SharesTraded
Field.Description: Number of shares traded for a security.

Field.Name: HighPrice
Field.Description: Highest trade price currently performed for a security. 3 implied decimal places.

Field.Name: LowPrice
Field.Description: Lowest trade price currently performed for a security. 3 implied decimal places.

Field.Name: LastPrice
Field.Description: Last trade price for a security. For MarketCode=ASHR this is updated with Close price at Market Close. 3 implied decimal places.

Field.Name: OpeningPrice
Field.Description: Opening price for a security. 3 implied decimal places.
